description: Use this when the user wants to approve the KYC questionnaire an investor submitted to one of their funds. Starts the approval of the questionnaires they name. Returns Capital Company’s next question, or the proposed approvals, with any issues flagged on each questionnaire, for the user to confirm. This call approves nothing.

request.description: What the user asked for, in their own words

team.description: The team to act on, by name, only when the user belongs to more than one team; leave it out otherwise

timeZone.description: The user’s IANA time zone, such as America/New_York

name: capital_company_approve_investor_kyc
title: Approve investors’ KYC
